newsitem.title: USA: Peerless invests in Online Resources.
newsitem.headline: Peerless invests in Online Resources.

text.p: Peerless Group Inc said Tuesday it had made a $2.5-million investment in a firm that provides electronic financial services like online banking.
Peerless said it made the convertible preferred stock investment in Online Resources & Communications Corp in order to expand electronic banking services to its customers.
Online of McLean, Virginia, recently completed a private placement of about $20 million of convertible preferred stock, it said.

Peerless, which offers information technology such as data processing to community banks and credit unions, also said it will remarket Online's interactive, remote banking services including Internet banking and bill payment.
It said it expected to roll out these additional services to customers in early 1998.
